{{Quote|Mwuhahahaa... my potion was a success. I was able to foresee many visions due to my power as a Sister. I have one last command for you, slave... then I shall actually release you, as per my vision.|[[Charal]]|<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Charal]], a [[Witch/Legends|witch]] marooned on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], was able to prepare a '''poultice''' that helped her [[Force vision/Legends|divine the future]]. It consisted of the [[spleen]] of a healthy [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]], various [[Plant/Legends|herbs]] from the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] and one globule of saliva from an Ewok's fang. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Charal enlisted a passing by [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to collect the ingredients she needed.
